title: Merlin design-repo PageSpec
description: Machine contract for a generated page. Draft-07. Closed everywhere (additionalProperties:false). The semantic layer (semantic_validate.py) enforces template/node cross-reference, rhythm rules, maxWords, asset policies. Styling is owned by the section contracts; the only token surface is the closed page-level `tokens` slot set (token-policy.json pageSpecTokenSlots), whose values must be approved catalog token paths. pageSpecVersion 2.0.0 added the required `mode`, `theme` and `tokens`.

pageSpecVersion.description: DOCUMENTATION ONLY marker; nothing machine-checks it.

mode.description: REQUIRED generation context (BASELINE R1). clone = faithful reconstruction of the source (real brand, copy and assets may be reused for fidelity). generation = a new page for someone else built from this design-repo: schema/semantic_validate.py rejects source identity and content (GENERATION_MODE_* rules).

theme.description: Theme of tokens/llm/token-catalog.json the page renders in (the source has one theme). TOKEN_THEME_COMBINATION checks every token against it.

tokens.description: Page-level design tokens, each a catalog path from tokens/llm/token-catalog.json. Closed set of slots = tokens/llm/token-policy.json pageSpecTokenSlots. Whether a value is a real, approved, slot-compatible, theme-valid token is checked by schema/semantic_validate.py (TOKEN_* rules): raw colours, lengths and font names are rejected there.

installerHref.description: mode=clone: the clone's local stub /download-stub.txt (stands in for the real installer host). mode=generation: /installer-placeholder.txt (the stub path is source identity, GENERATION_MODE_URL).
